iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

L7CHECK::protocol
       Set or get L7 protocol value.

SYNOPSIS
       L7CHECK::protocol set VALUE

       L7CHECK::protocol get

DESCRIPTION
       The L7CHECK::protocol commands allow you to set or retrieve L7 protocol value.

       Syntax

       L7CHECK::protocol set

	       * Sets the L7 protocol value.

       L7CHECK::protocol get

	       * Returns the L7 protocol value.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       L7CHECK_CLIENT_DATA, L7CHECK_SERVER_DATA, CONNECTOR_OPEN

EXAMPLES
	when L7CHECK_CLIENT_DATA {
	    if { [L7CHECK::protocol get] == "https" } {
		pool clients_https
	    } else {
		pool clients_non_https
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-14.0.0 --First introduced the command.
